title: EntityPayload
description:
The payload of an `entity` artifact: EntityIR v1 (`objectKind` and a
`fields` map; no `entityVersion`) or EntityIR v2 (`entityVersion`
"2.0" and exactly one definition: `objectType`, `interface`,
`objectTypeExtension`, `propertyTypes`, or `markings`). V1 fields and
V2 definitions can both declare default-empty marking lists.

anyOf.description: v2: one extension of an object type another layer owns.
v2: a catalog of shared property types.
v2: a catalog of data markings.

AccountingLegDeclaration.description:
How an object type declares a stored exact GL leg and its journal identity.

`journal_id_property` groups each committed leg into the journal identified
by its journal identity; `leg_property` stores the complete
exact [`AccountingLegIr`] value. The type-level declaration makes every
write to that object type discoverable by the shared kernel commit check.

journalIdProperty.description: Property whose non-empty text value is the posting's journal id.

legProperty.description: Property whose JSON value is a serialized accounting leg.

CalendarDate.description: An ISO 8601 calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD` with no time and no zone.

ComponentNormalization.description: The normalization steps for one key component.

property.description: A component of the enclosing key; its kind must be `text`.

ConstraintClass.description: How a declared invariant is applied at a write boundary.

oneOf.description:
A command that would violate the invariant is refused atomically.
Observations still record the external state and emit a finding.

A violation does not refuse a command or observation. Observed
violations produce expectation findings.

DecimalLiteral.description:
An exact decimal number written as a JSON string: an optional `-`, an
integer part without leading zeros, and an optional fraction
(`"0"`, `"-12"`, `"19.990"`). No exponent, no `+`.

Trailing fraction zeros are kept: they carry the literal's scale.

DefaultValue.description:
A literal default value of a property's type (any JSON except `null`).

The literal's shape per kind (checked by `norn-checker`): a string for
`text`, `enum`, `date`, and `timestamp`; an exact decimal string for
`integer` and `decimal`; a boolean for `boolean`; any JSON for `json-ext`.

DimensionPath.description: A property reached by zero or more declared directional link roles.

links.description: Forward or inverse roles, in traversal order; empty means the root object.

EntityAuthorityDomain.description: A hard-invariant domain that may own an entity type's mutations.

EntityExtensionRootV2.description:
EntityIR v2 payload of an `entity` artifact that carries one extension of
an object type another layer owns. (`extensions` stays the reserved
extension-slot map every payload root has.)

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

EntityFieldV1.description: One EntityIR v1 field definition, tagged by `type`.

markings.description: Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.
Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.
Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.
Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.
Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.
Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.
Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.

oneOf.description:
A closed set of string values: non-empty, unique, and each non-blank
(checker rules).

markings.description: Classification markings declared on this field. Omitted when empty.

EntityInterfaceRootV2.description: EntityIR v2 payload of an `entity` artifact that carries one interface.

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

EntityMutationAuthority.description:
Who may mutate objects of an entity type (the closed EntityIR authority
descriptor; the engine's final admission predicate is
[`crate::entity_mutation_authority_admits`]).

oneOf.description: Ordinary generic actions (the default when omitted).
Only commands of one hard-invariant domain engine.

EntityRootV1.description: EntityIR v1 payload of an `entity` artifact (the map-backed form).

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

fields.description: Field name → field definition. Names are non-empty (checker rule).

markings.description: Classification markings inherited by every field. Omitted when empty.

mutationAuthority.description: Who may mutate objects of this kind. Omitted: generic actions.

objectKind.description:
The object kind: an exact identity without whitespace, control
characters, or wildcards (checker rule).

overlaySources.description:
Customization artifact ids whose `add_field` overlays the engine
applied, in application order. Each is a non-empty string (checker
rule); the list may be empty.

EntityRootV2.description: EntityIR v2 payload of an `entity` artifact: one object type.

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

mutationAuthority.description: Who may mutate objects of this type. Omitted: generic actions.

objectType.description:
The object type. Its `name` is the artifact's object kind (v1
`objectKind`), and its `links` are the type's relations.

EnumValue.description: One declared value of an `enum` property.

value.description: The stored value; stable once published.

ExtensionNamespace.description:
The namespace a tenant (or a package) adds members under (`acme`).
Allocated by the registry (T8-REG-4); unique per tenant.

IdentityRule.description:
A declared identity rule: normalization applied to key components before
comparison, and the entity-resolution policy that matches incoming records
to existing objects (T8-ID-1 resolves the reference and runs the policy).

matchPolicy.description:
Name of the entity-resolution policy artifact (T8-ID-1). Omitted:
records match only on equal normalized key values.

normalize.description:
Per-component normalization, applied in step order. Omitted when
empty.

InterfaceDef.description:
An interface: the properties and links every implementing object type
has, and the invariants every such object satisfies.

invariants.description:
Invariants every implementing object type satisfies, in addition to
its own and inherited invariants. Omitted when empty.

links.description:
Required links, in presentation order; their ids are distinct from
the required property ids. Omitted when empty.

markings.description:
Classification markings inherited by every implementing property.
Omitted when empty.

name.description: Unique name, across interfaces and object types.

properties.description: Required properties, in presentation order. Omitted when empty.

status.description: The definition's resource status. Omitted means `active`.

InterfaceLink.description:
One required link of an interface: every implementing type has a link
with this id whose target and cardinality narrow the requirement's.

A requirement names no inverse and no link properties: an interface is a
read contract on the implementing type, and cannot add members to the
target.

cardinality.description: The widest cardinality an implementing link may have.

id.description: Unique id among the interface's requirements; never contains `__`.

target.description:
The widest target an implementing link may have: an object type (or
a subtype of it) or an interface (or a type implementing it).

InterfaceName.description:
Qualified name of an interface: the object type name grammar
([`OBJECT_TYPE_NAME_PATTERN`], `party.Party`). Interfaces and object types
share one name space.

InterfaceProperty.description:
One required property of an interface: an id, a type an implementing
property must narrow, and constraints that apply to it.

A requirement has no default and is never `computed`: an interface is a
read contract, and an implementing type may satisfy it with a stored or a
computed property.

constraints.description:
Constraints every implementing property is held to. Omitted when
empty.

id.description: Unique id within the interface; never contains `__`.

markings.description:
Classification markings required of every implementing property.
Implementations may add markings but cannot remove these. Omitted when
empty.

type.description: The widest type an implementing property may have.

Invariant.description: One declared invariant of an object type or interface.

classification.description:
Whether violations reject commands (`integrity`) or remain findings
(`quality`). Omitted wire values mean `integrity` for compatibility.

expression.description: A boolean ZEN Expression over the object's or interface's properties.

id.description: Unique id among the type's invariants, inherited ones included.

message.description: What a commit that violates the invariant reports; non-blank.

InvariantId.description:
Id of an [`Invariant`], unique within its owner's effective invariant
contract. Same grammar as a property id ([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]); invariants
have their own name space.

KeyName.description:
Name of a [`KeySpec`] within its object type (`primary`, `by_email`),
unique there.

KeySpec.description: One declared key: an ordered list of property ids.

name.description: Unique name within the object type.

namingSeries.description:
Generates one stored text component of this key inside the atomic
create commit. Omitted for caller-supplied keys.

properties.description:
The key's components, in tuple order: one id for a single key, several
for a composite key. Each names a stored, non-nullable property of an
admissible kind.

rule.description:
How key values are normalized and matched. Omitted: components compare
exactly as stored.

Lifecycle.description: The declared state machine of one `enum` property of an object type.

immutable.description:
States in which non-lifecycle properties cannot be written. Declared
transitions may still leave these states. Omitted when empty.

initial.description:
The states a new object may be created in; non-empty. The property's
default, if any, must be one of them.

pathProperties.description:
Structural ordering laws, checked over every declared transition path.
Guards can remove paths but cannot introduce a path that avoids `via`.

property.description:
The lifecycle property: a stored, non-nullable `enum` property of the
type (declared, inherited, or added by an extension). Its values are
the states.

terminal.description:
Absorbing states: no transition leaves them. Every other state has at
least one outgoing transition. Omitted when empty.

transitions.description:
The allowed transitions, in presentation order. A write that changes
the property from `a` to `b` is allowed exactly when a transition has
`a` in `from` and `to == b`. Omitted when empty.

LifecyclePathProperty.description:
Every path from an initial state to `target` must visit `via`, including
the initial and target states. An unreachable target satisfies this law
vacuously, but is independently rejected by the reachability check.

via.description: Required state on every path to the destination.

Link.description: One link of an object type (or of an extension of one).

acyclic.description:
Whether this forward role must be acyclic in the final cell graph.
Omitted means false. Subtype overrides must preserve true.

cardinality.description: Multiplicity of both ends, and whether the link is required.

id.description:
The forward role: unique among the source type's members
(properties, links, and inverse roles).

inverse.description:
The inverse role: the member of the target (and of every subtype or
implementor of it) that traverses back to the source, with the
multiplicity `cardinality.from`. Omitted: the relation is traversed
only forward by name.

properties.description:
Link properties: attributes of each link instance (a relationship
object), with the shape of object type properties. Omitted when
empty.

target.description:
The object type or interface linked to (they share one name space).
A link to an interface admits every type that implements it.

LinkCardinality.description:
The cardinality of a link, declared on both ends.

`to` and `from` together give the relation's shape: `one`/`one` is 1:1,
`one`/`many` is N:1 from the source (1:N from the target), and
`many`/`many` is N:M. `required` is Gel's `required`: every source object
links to at least one target.

from.description:
How many source objects link to one target: the multiplicity of the
inverse role.

required.description:
Whether every source object links to at least one target. Defaults to
`false`; the canonical form omits `false`.

to.description: How many targets one source object links to.

LinkId.description:
A role name of a link: the link id on the source type, or the inverse
on the target type. Same grammar as a property id
([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]); properties, links, and inverse roles share one
member name space per object type.

MarkingCatalogRootV2.description:
EntityIR v2 payload of an `entity` artifact that carries data marking
definitions.

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

markings.description: The marking definitions, in presentation order.

MarkingId.description: Stable identity of a data marking.

MarkingIr.description: A declared classification and its read projection policy.

id.description: Stable id used by definitions and `reveal` grants.

mask.description: Read projection used when the principal cannot reveal this marking.

oneOf.description: Lower-risk internal classification.
Sensitive data that needs routine protection.
High-impact data that should be tightly restricted.
The strongest sensitivity level.

MaskPolicy.description: The projection applied when a principal lacks `reveal` for a marking.

oneOf.description: Replace the value with a redaction marker.
Keep only the final `count` characters.

count.description: Number of trailing characters to retain; must be greater than zero.

oneOf.description: Replace the value with JSON null.

Multiplicity.description: How many objects one end of a link may relate to (Gel `single`/`multi`).

oneOf.description: At most one.
Any number.

NamingGapPolicy.description: Whether allocations may leave gaps in the business numbering sequence.

oneOf.description:
Counter advancement is committed only with the containing create
transaction, so a refused or aborted commit consumes no number.

The allocator may skip a candidate number already occupied by an
imported or existing key while completing the same atomic create.

NamingResetPolicy.description: The local calendar boundary at which a naming-series counter resets.

oneOf.description: Keep one counter for all time, regardless of date tokens in the pattern.
Start a new counter for each local calendar year.
Start a new counter for each local calendar month.
Start a new counter for each local calendar day.

NamingSeriesIR.description:
A naming-series declaration attached to one generated entity key.

`pattern` is a sequence of literal text and brace tokens: `{YYYY}`, `{YY}`,
`{MM}`, `{DD}`, `{#####}` (one to eighteen `#` characters), and
`{property_id}` for every property in `scope_fields`. The checker validates
the grammar and cross-field constraints.

gapPolicy.description:
Whether committed counter allocations must be contiguous within one
commit or may leave gaps under the runtime policy.

pattern.description: Literal text and supported placeholders for the generated key value.

resetPolicy.description: Counter reset boundary. Reset periods are rendered in `timezone`.

scopeFields.description:
Required text properties substituted by matching `{property_id}`
tokens. Omitted when the series has no scope fields.

timezone.description: Explicit IANA timezone used to derive date tokens from the commit time.

oneOf.description: Remove leading and trailing Unicode whitespace.
Replace each run of Unicode whitespace with one space.
Unicode default lower-casing.
Unicode default upper-casing.
Unicode Normalization Form C.
Unicode Normalization Form KC (compatibility composition).

ObjectTypeDef.description:
An object type: its resource status, supertype, interfaces, properties,
links, identity, invariants, and declared lifecycles.

The name's namespace is the type's domain namespace
([`ObjectTypeName::domain`]); there is no separate `domain` member.
Properties, links, and the inverse roles of links that target the type
share one member name space.

accountingLeg.description:
Marks this type's facts as GL legs for runtime balanced-posting checks.
Inherited by subtypes. Omitted for object types that are not GL legs.

extends.description:
The single supertype. The subtype inherits every property, key, and
implemented interface, and may only narrow inherited properties.

identity.description:
Declared keys. Each is unique among the type's live objects within one
tenant scope and world, enforced at commit. Omitted when empty: every
object always has its kernel-assigned object id, and a type need not
declare a business key.

implements.description:
Interfaces the type implements, in addition to those its supertypes
implement. Omitted when empty.

invariants.description:
Declared invariants, in addition to every supertype's. Omitted when
empty.

lifecycles.description:
Declared lifecycles: the allowed transitions of `enum` properties, at
most one per property. New lifecycles, and narrowing redeclarations of
inherited ones (same property). Omitted when empty.

links.description:
Declared links, in presentation order: new links, and narrowing
overrides of inherited ones (same id). Omitted when empty.

markings.description:
Classification markings inherited by the type and its properties.
Omitted when empty.

name.description:
Unique name, across object types and interfaces, within the artifact
set and against every installed base type.

ownedCollections.description:
Declared owned child collections. Each collection is backed by a
declared many/from-one link and keeps membership and order as part of
the parent's transactional write boundary. Omitted when empty.

properties.description:
Declared properties, in presentation order: new properties, and
narrowing overrides of inherited ones (same id). Omitted when empty.

status.description:
The definition's resource status. Omitted means `active` (the
canonical form omits it).

ObjectTypeExtension.description:
Members one layer adds to an object type it does not own.

The members apply to the target and every subtype of it. An extension
cannot remove, rename, or change a member of the target, and cannot add a
key or an invariant: identity and invariants belong to the type's owner.

links.description:
Added links; each id, and each inverse role, is
`<namespace>__<name>`. Omitted when empty.

namespace.description: The namespace every added member id is prefixed with.

properties.description:
Added properties; each id is `<namespace>__<name>`. Omitted when
empty.

ObjectTypeName.description:
Qualified name of an object type: dotted lower-case namespace segments and
a PascalCase type name (`retail.Sku`, `hr.Employee`), the form v1
`objectKind` already uses. The namespace segments are the type's domain
namespace ([`Self::domain`]).

OwnedChildCollection.description: A declared, parent-owned ordered collection of child objects.

cascadeOnParentDelete.description: Whether parent deletion cascades through these rows.

childType.description: Exact child object type accepted by the owning link.

id.description: The parent-to-child link that owns the collection.

maxRows.description: Maximum live rows (bounded by the platform limit of 100).

orderingKey.description: Stored exact-integer property holding dense 1-based row order.

rowIdProperty.description: Stable child property equal to the child fact key.

Property.description: One property of an object type.

computed.description:
A ZEN Expression over the object's other properties. A computed
property is derived and read-only: no action writes it, and it has no
default. It reads the object through `self` (`self.quantity`); the
checker parses it (T1-ONT-2) and types it (T1-EXPR-5).

constraints.description:
Constraints on this property's values, in addition to those of a
`ref`'d shared type. Omitted when empty.

default.description: The value a new object takes when its creator supplies none.

id.description: Unique id within the object type.

markings.description:
Classification markings declared on this property. Markings from
property types, interfaces, supertypes, and computed inputs are unioned
by the checker and cannot be removed by narrowing. Omitted when empty.

type.description: The value kind: inline, or a shared property type through `ref`.

PropertyConstraints.description:
Constraints on the values of a property type.

Applicability (checked by `norn-checker`): `min`/`max` apply to `integer`
and `decimal`; `minLength`/`maxLength`/`pattern` apply to `text`;
`nullable` applies to every kind. Through a `ref` they apply to the
referenced type's kind.

maxLength.description: Maximum length in Unicode scalar values.

minLength.description: Minimum length in Unicode scalar values.

nullable.description:
Whether a value may be absent (`null`). Defaults to `false`; the
canonical form omits `false`.

pattern.description:
A regular expression the value must contain a match for (JSON Schema
`pattern` semantics: unanchored; write `^…$` for a full match). The
dialect is `regex-lite`, the ZEN Expression pure profile's engine.

PropertyId.description: Id of a property within its object type (`sku_code`), unique there.

PropertyType.description: The value kind of a property, tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: A Unicode string, optionally in a well-known [`TextFormat`].
A signed 64-bit integer.

An exact decimal with a fixed number of fraction digits, optionally a
quantity in a declared unit.

currencySource.description:
Authoritative currency path relative to the object holding this amount.
Monetary decimals declare this instead of a quantity unit. Metrics
must verify this source; descriptions and names carry no semantics.

scale.description:
Fraction digits every value is held at (`2` for cents). At most 28,
the exact range of ZEN Expression's decimal (checked by
`norn-checker`).

oneOf.description: `true` or `false`.
An instant in time with an explicit timezone policy.

timezone.description: How the offset is held. Required: there is no ambient timezone.

oneOf.description: An ISO 8601 calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) with no time and no zone.

An exact elapsed duration (fixed-length units only; calendar periods
such as months are not durations).
One of a closed set of string values.

values.description: Declared values, in presentation order; unique and non-empty.

oneOf.description:
A closed structured value. Every member is present; nullability of
the containing property applies to the whole record.

Opaque JSON (an extension payload), optionally described by a JSON
Schema document the checker does not interpret.
The shared property type (local or registry) with this name.

PropertyTypeCatalogRootV2.description:
EntityIR v2 payload of an `entity` artifact that carries a catalog of
shared property types (non-empty; checker rule).

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

propertyTypes.description: The shared property types, in presentation order.

PropertyTypeDef.description:
A reusable, named property type: the unit of reuse across object types
(Foundry "shared property type", LinkML `type`).

constraints.description: Constraints on values of this type. Omitted when empty.

markings.description:
Classification markings applied to every property using this type.
Omitted when empty.

name.description: Unique name within the artifact set (and against registry names).

PropertyTypeName.description:
Dotted, lower-case name of a shared property type, for example
`commerce.sku_code` or the registry value type `iso4217.currency_code`.

Grammar (checked by `norn-checker`): one or more `.`-separated segments,
each `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`.

RecordMember.description:
One required member of a closed record. A nullable member must still be
present, with an explicit null when it has no value.

constraints.description: Constraints on this required member, including its nullability.

id.description: Unique member name, using the property id grammar.

type.description: Inline member kind or a reference to a shared property type.

ResolutionPolicyName.description:
Dotted, lower-case name of an entity-resolution policy artifact
(`party.email_exact`); same grammar as a property type name
([`super::property::PROPERTY_TYPE_NAME_PATTERN`]).

ResourceStatus.description:
The resource status of a definition named by `N` (an object type or an
interface), tagged by `state`.

oneOf.description: Published for trial; its shape may still change incompatibly.
Stable: changes follow the compatibility rules of its package.
Still valid, but new use is discouraged.

replacedBy.description: The definition that replaces it, of the same kind.

since.description: The date the definition was deprecated.

ResourceStatus2.description:
The resource status of a definition named by `N` (an object type or an
interface), tagged by `state`.

oneOf.description: Published for trial; its shape may still change incompatibly.
Stable: changes follow the compatibility rules of its package.
Still valid, but new use is discouraged.

replacedBy.description: The definition that replaces it, of the same kind.

since.description: The date the definition was deprecated.

TextFormat.description: Well-known string formats of a `text` property.

oneOf.description: An RFC 5322 address (`addr-spec`).
An RFC 3986 URI.
An RFC 9562 UUID in its hyphenated text form.

TimezonePolicy.description:
A timestamp's declared source-offset policy. Both policies require an
RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset; neither admits a local
date-time. Runtime storage canonicalizes both to UTC (#3112); raw source
observations retain the original offset as source evidence.

oneOf.description: An instant normalized to UTC (`Z`); the source offset is not kept.

Source data supplies an offset. The runtime stores the instant in UTC;
the original source representation belongs to raw observations.

Transition.description: One named, allowed change of the lifecycle property.

from.description: The source states, non-empty and distinct; none is `to`.

guards.description:
Boolean ZEN Expressions over the object's properties, evaluated on
the state before the change; the transition may be taken only when
every one holds (their conjunction). A subtype that redeclares the
transition restates every inherited guard verbatim and may append its
own, so the declaration it carries is the full effective guard set;
dropping or replacing an inherited guard is a checker error. A guard
reads the object through `self`; the checker parses it (T1-ONT-2)
and types it (T1-EXPR-5, #2523); enforcement at commit is the
kernel's. Omitted when empty.

TransitionId.description:
Id of a [`Transition`], unique within its lifecycle. Same grammar as a
property id ([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]).

UnitRef.description:
A reference to a unit of measure in a standard unit vocabulary (ruling
2026-09-25 §27). The code is not interpreted here; resolving it against the
vocabulary is registry work (T8-STD-1).

oneOf.description: The Unified Code for Units of Measure (case-sensitive codes).
A QUDT unit (`unit:` local name).

WholeNumber.description:
A non-negative integral JSON number.

IR JSON numbers are binary64 ([`JsonValue::Number`]), so a count written
as `3` and one decoded as `3.0` are the same value. This accepts any
integral, non-negative number up to 2^53 (the exact-integer range of
binary64), matching the validators' `fract() == 0.0` checks; each member's
lower bound stays a checker rule.

ZenExpression.description:
Source text of one ZEN Expression (the IR's single expression language,
ruling 2026-09-25 §3): a decision-table cell, switch condition, expression
assignment, or action precondition.

Stored verbatim; parsing and type checking belong to `norn-expr` and
`norn-checker`.
